system.description:
You exhale wind release chakra onto a weapon to increase its sharpness, range and lethality. This can even be used on your unarmed strikes creating lethal blades of wind extending from those strikes.

Enhanced weapon or unarmed strike’s deals an additional 2d8 wind damage twice per turn, its range is also increased by 10 feet. ranged weapons also damage all adjacent spaces around its target on a successful hit.

At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above B-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3. If cast at S-Rank, increase the damage of this jutsu by +1d8.
